Name: Lusif1's NPC Template
Author: lusif1
Description:
This is an easy to read, easy to follow template, that by the end of it, you WILL have a barebones working NPC. If you want to know more, check out the Stardew valley modding wiki.

HOW DO I USE IT?!?!

Just install the mod the way you normally would, but extract to desktop. Inside the folder will be a ReadMe.txt. The ReadMe will tell you everything you need to know! Happy modding!

DISCLAIMER: THIS TEMPLATE IS FOR THE LATEST SDV VERSION AS OF 11/10/2023, WHICH IS 1.5.6 AND BELOW. THIS TEMPLATE WILL GET AN UPDATE FOR 1.6 UPON RELEASE, SINCE IT CHANGES SOME NPC JSON 'CODE'
